title: Slate -- the Chair's draft of the committee's agreed best (R34, R36 round 4)
x_purpose: At most 15 tickets across ADVANCE and WATCH (a ceiling, not a target; never padded). Each ticket carries its entry trigger, where it is wrong, horizon, why the room agrees and who dissents and why. The Chair uses ONLY what the seats said in their case forms and floor messages; it adds no view and never judges the quality of a reason. ADVANCE = the committee wants to act on the trigger. WATCH = it wants the name but is waiting on a condition (rendered WATCH; machine verdict HOLD-FOR-CONDITIONS so every downstream reader is unchanged). R40 (PM 2026-11-02): the verdict and the ONE trigger on each ticket are FIXED BY CODE in decision.json (pma_pipeline.py decide-timing); the Chair writes why_agreed and dissent in the seats' words and may not change either. One slate-wide market_kill line (the modal market_void from tier 2) rides with the slate.

chair.x_note: the Chair is not a voice (R36)

board_sha256.x_note: sha256 of board.json the slate was drafted from

ticker.x_note: must be in the deliberation set; unique

entry_trigger.x_note: = trigger.plain (kept for every downstream reader); for WATCH it is the condition the room waits on followed by the trigger

horizon_sessions.x_note: the horizon the agreeing seats stated (the Chair reports; it does not invent)

why_agreed.x_note: in the seats' words; attribute by name

sources.x_note: msg_ids and 'r2:<voice>' the ticket was built from

trigger.x_note: R40: the ONE trigger, copied from decision.json for this ticker (word + timeframe + plain); the registrar REJECTS a ticket whose trigger or verdict differs from decision.json

timing_count.x_note: copied from decision.json: {support, act_now, wait, oppose, abstain}

decision_sha256.x_note: sha256 of decision.json the slate was built from

market_kill.x_note: R40: ONE slate-wide market condition that voids every new trigger, from decide-timing (the modal market_void); null only when no seat named one -- declared, never invented by the Chair

x_registrar_extra_checks: every ticker in phase4 deliberation_set; no duplicates
why_agreed / wrong_if using a bracket as a disqualifier => REJECT (R1)
with --decision decision.json: every ticket's verdict == decision verdict and trigger == decision trigger (word, tf) => else REJECT (R40)
with --decision: a ticket for a name decision.json did not slate (support < 4) => REJECT; a slated name missing from the slate is allowed only over the 15 cap, listed in slate_excluded.json
